services.desc: On May 11, 1936 - 85 years ago - the Merchant’s House officially opened its doors to the public as a museum. The founder, George Chapman, exclaimed: “Here in Fourth Street stands a house that is really Old New York itself! You can mount its marble steps and ring its bell, and be carried back to the 1830s, into the life of the Seabury Tredwell family, who lived here for almost a hundred years … The whole house whispers of their lives. Everything you see was theirs, nothing has been added.
